frame_operation: Finish or resume the current film/storyboard operation before regenerating a frame from its card.
continue_operation: There is no storyboard ready to continue. Finish the current operation first.
frame_done: Frame {frame} updated. Other frames were not regenerated. Explicitly continue the film to update the video.
frames_ready: Storyboard ready. Preview and edit individual frames, then continue the film when satisfied.
env_symlink: The local .env is a symlink. Edit it directly or save for this session only.
film_invalid: The original CLI cannot load film.json: {detail}
instance: A workbench service is already running for this repository. Use that page or stop the service before changing ports.
number: must be a finite number between {low} and {high}
missing_image: Reference image not found: {path}. Upload and bind an image, or check its path relative to the repository root.
image: Invalid or unsupported image: {path}. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
keys: Live generation needs: {names}. Configure keys or use offline demo mode.
ffmpeg: Live generation requires ffmpeg and ffprobe. Install them and restart the workbench.
busy: A task is already running. Wait for it to finish.
output: Output directory already exists and is not empty: {path}. Choose a new directory, or resume the original task from history.
output_reserved: Cannot use the workbench internal directory for output: {path}
resume: Only failed or interrupted tasks can be resumed.
alive: The original process is still running (PID {pid}). Wait before resuming to avoid duplicate submissions.
origin: Local same-origin requests only. Use the workbench page.
upload: Select 1–9 images, up to 32 MB per upload.
exit: Task exited with code {code}. See logs. Failed tasks can resume with the original inputs.
interrupted: The local service stopped before completion was confirmed. Cloud tasks may still run; resume the original task to check.
demo_start: Offline demo: no network, no models, no charges.
demo_no_video: ffmpeg / ffprobe not found. Only plan, storyboard placeholders and report will be generated; no video.
demo_video: The video contains static DEMO placeholders, solely for testing playback and downloads.
